{
  "summary": "Focused claim o-997c30f9b4aabc09 (g0003): the old harness checks the XInclude context error after processing, but the supplied evidence cannot establish whether an injected allocation failure makes that check fail on either source version.",
  "coverage_complete": false,
  "coverage_evidence": [],
  "missing_information": [
    "The effect of error.c::xmlRaiseMemoryError on the XInclude context's errNo field is not supplied.",
    "The installed allocator callbacks and URL propagation needed to establish a feasible input-controlled failure at the shown processing site are not supplied."
  ],
  "requested_symbols": [
    "error.c::xmlRaiseMemoryError",
    "fuzz/fuzz.c::xmlFuzzMemSetup",
    "the allocator callbacks installed by xmlFuzzMemSetup",
    "parser.c::xmlDoRead"
  ],
  "requested_paths": [
    "error.c",
    "fuzz/fuzz.c",
    "parser.c"
  ],
  "assessment": {
    "necessary": "unknown",
    "necessity_reason": "The before reporter assigns XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to the context; the after reporter delegates error reporting. A feasible injected failure and the delegate's effect on the context error are unresolved.",
    "before": {
      "requirement": "When an injected allocation failure is reported during XInclude processing, xmlXIncludeGetLastError must return XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY for the existing harness check.",
      "applicability": "required",
      "harness_status": "unknown",
      "reason": "The reporter directly assigns the expected error code, but the supplied allocator and document URL path do not establish a feasible input that reaches the shown failure site.",
      "source_evidence": [
        {
          "unit_id": "u-fd0ee43254fd372c2f9c",
          "start_line": 130,
          "end_line": 141,
          "role": "primary",
          "dependency_reason": ""
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-973f827390e4d58b764a",
          "start_line": 2384,
          "end_line": 2389,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "The getter returns the context errNo field checked by the harness."
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-1161a5b723d91ac96321",
          "start_line": 2355,
          "end_line": 2368,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "A failed base URL allocation calls the memory-error reporter and returns before further processing."
        }
      ]
    },
    "after": {
      "requirement": "For the same reported allocation failure, xmlXIncludeGetLastError must return XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY for the existing harness check.",
      "applicability": "required",
      "harness_status": "unknown",
      "reason": "The changed reporter calls xmlRaiseMemoryError without directly assigning errNo. Its effect on that field is not supplied, and feasibility of the injected failure remains unresolved.",
      "source_evidence": [
        {
          "unit_id": "u-37bf4d3e35073e6d1dcb",
          "start_line": 133,
          "end_line": 138,
          "role": "primary",
          "dependency_reason": ""
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-a71dca9a1aab66553649",
          "start_line": 2363,
          "end_line": 2368,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "The getter still returns the context errNo field."
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-25960cc3e8622072d1c7",
          "start_line": 2334,
          "end_line": 2347,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "The corresponding base URL allocation failure calls the changed reporter and returns."
        }
      ]
    },
    "same_blocker": "unknown",
    "harness_evidence": [
      {
        "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
        "start_line": 37,
        "end_line": 69,
        "role": "primary",
        "dependency_reason": ""
      },
      {
        "unit_id": "u-ab97f2d7a2b55b1a45d3",
        "start_line": 121,
        "end_line": 128,
        "role": "dependency",
        "dependency_reason": "The existing check aborts when the recorded allocation failure differs from the expected context error state."
      }
    ],
    "comparison_reason": "The same old check applies on both sides. The direct errNo assignment disappears after the change, but the supplied evidence establishes neither a feasible input-controlled failure nor the delegated reporter's final effect on errNo.",
    "missing_information": [
      "Complete error.c::xmlRaiseMemoryError on the after side, including its effect when the supplied handler and handler context are NULL.",
      "Complete fuzz/fuzz.c::xmlFuzzMemSetup and its installed allocator callbacks, to establish how the input-derived limit triggers allocation failure.",
      "Complete parser.c::xmlDoRead on both sides, to establish whether the harness-supplied URL reaches tree->doc->URL at the shown failure site."
    ]
  }
}
